xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex19082023-03-0908-24-527" status="unreviewed">bsdus don gyis <lb n="3a4"/><abbr>'bras bu</abbr> bshad yin ¦ nas ni ces pa mtshams sbyor gyi tshig ste bya ba gzhan 'dren par byed pa yin la / de yang phyag gi yul klu sgrub de yis mdzad pa'i dbu ma rtsa ba'i tshig le'ur byas pa'i 'grel pa bya ces sbyor ro || ci 'dra cig byed ce na ¦ khyad par bzhi ldan ste ¦ tshig mtshams 'byor zhing don gsal bas slu ba dang ¦ sdeb sbyor gyi gtsug lag dang mthun zhing khyad par<lb n="3a5"/> gyi gzhi ngag don khags pa dang ¦ dbu ma'i don ¦ chos rnaMs la bden par rtog pa'i rlung gis ma dkrugs pa dang / tshig gi <abbr>'bras bu</abbr> gnyer ba dang don gyi mtshams sbyor lasogs bshad dgos pa mi 'chad pa ma yin te legs par 'chad pa dang ¦ gzhung mthong pa tsam gyis don go bas bshad mi dgos pa mi 'chad pa dang ¦ rtsa ba mkhan po'i dgongs pa mi 'chad pa ma <lb n="3a6"/> yin te legs par 'chad pa dang ¦ de las gzhan skabs su ma bab pa 'chad pa ma yin te skabs su bab pa nyid 'chad pa dang / brjod bya'i gtso bo la mi sbyor ba ma yin skabs kyi brjod bya ngos bzung nas ston pas ¦ rab tu gsal ba cig bya'o ces pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kha cig</rs> gi'o ||</seg></TEI>
